item.title: Rogan says voters feel 'betrayed' by Trump's Iran campaign after he pledged 'no more wars' for years
item.summary: The U.S. strikes on Iran contradict President Donald Trump's 2024 campaign pledge to avoid wars, podcast host Joe Rogan said Tuesday while discussing the conflict.

item.title: CNN botches New York terrorist attack coverage, forced to issue multiple corrections
item.summary: CNN has had a rough week covering the alleged ISIS-inspired terror attack in New York City, issuing a pair of embarrassing apologies after facing significant online backlash.

item.title: Bird strike forces major airline to turn around after windshield is cracked midair
item.summary: After a bird strike caused a cracked windshield and pressurization issues on a Boeing 737 flight to Jacksonville, a United Airlines flight safely returned to Newark.

item.title: Bipartisan housing push advances, but Trump-backed investor ban faces resistance
item.summary: Some Senate Democrats and industry groups oppose an institutional investor ban in a housing bill, arguing the provision would eliminate build-to-rent units and reduce rentals.

item.title: Trump administration puts key Biden-era immigration policy on notice: 'Unsustainable cycle'
item.summary: The Trump administration is looking to undo temporary protected status designations for hundreds of thousands of migrants in the U.S., which would reverse a key Biden-era policy.

item.title: Ex-Iranian women's soccer star empathizes with national team, breaks down sharing story of father's death
item.summary: Former Iranian women's soccer player Shiva Amini opened up on "The Story" about what the current national team could face from the regime.

item.title: Kristin Cavallari turns heads in beachside bikini photos showcasing her signature jewelry line
item.summary: Kristin Cavallari combines stunning beach photography with business savvy, promoting Uncommon James. She also offers real talk about divorce on her podcast.

item.title: Tarik Skubal calls Benedict Arnold comparisons from disgruntled Team USA fans 'just not fair'
item.summary: Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal faced backlash after leaving the World Baseball Classic early. Fans compared him to Benedict Arnold for returning to the Tigers.

item.title: Newsom knocked for ‘insane’ California gas prices after blaming Trump for rising costs
item.summary: Critics are calling out California Gov. Gavin Newsom's “insane" climate policies as the state’s prices at the pump soar significantly above the national average.

item.title: Six reported Bigfoot sightings in northeast Ohio within four days spark cryptid 'flap' speculation
item.summary: Six reported Bigfoot sightings in northeast Ohio spark cryptid buzz. Alleged encounters near Mantua and Garrettsville were described as possible "flap" event.
